'''Phil Gladney''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 random.convention tournament]] on 18 March 2001 with Big Blue and GMC with Sabacc, according to Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1929">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-team-atlanta-vs-the-a-s-s-3-18-01d1929/ team-atlanta-vs-the-a-s-s-3-18-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 20 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-team-atlanta-vs-the-a-s-s-3-18-01d1929/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
